Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Sanjay - 36 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Aditi - 11 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Aditi stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vihaan bursts out laughing.]

Aditi: "One more time!"

[Vihaan starts crying.]

Vihaan: "Aditi, look at this."

[Vihaan smiles at Mother.]

Vihaan: "What next?"

[Vihaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Meenakshi: "Aditi, listen!"

[Vihaan gets frightened and steps back.]

Aditi: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Aditi: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Vihaan (gently): "I knew it!"

[Vihaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Meenakshi: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

[Vihaan stands in the snow. Meenakshi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Vihaan (gently): "Okay, Dad."

[Vihaan makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Meenakshi: "One more time!"

[Vihaan builds a snowman.]

Vihaan: "Let's see."

[Vihaan catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Vihaan: "Dad, look at this."

[Vihaan slides down the snowy slope.]

Sanjay (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
